images.caption: Figure 2:Overview of the five-stage RA-Bench construction pipeline.We collect public videos from real-world crises and other socially consequential events, segment them into scene-level clips and screen near-duplicates, conduct two-round manual review, and apply release-oriented postprocessing to form the real anchor set. Each retained anchor is then paired with image-to-video (I2V) generated counterparts using first-frame conditioning and a shared prompting pipeline.
